lateral_reference_contract.phase_alignment: Exactly the same phase i/sample_count as joint rows. Low/high vectors are identical; cadence supplies units per second.
lateral_reference_contract.positive_direction: body translation along episode-left (+Y at initial heading), NOT foot offset
lateral_reference_contract.derivative_units: metres per unit global cycle phase; multiply by actual phase rate for m/s
lateral_reference_contract.startup_stop: Periodic waveform only. Controller startup amplitude ramp and post-run recentering must be handled explicitly; these arrays do not silently redefine a stop target.

contact_schedule.proof: Contact masks are constant between listed phase events; every open event interval has >=3 scheduled supports.

kinematics.corner_transform: Construct sagittal corners including hip offset, then Rx(side*abduction). Solve both structural and tread lower-corner depths while every tread center Y=side*hip_outward-body_shift_Y.

generation.forward_push_derivation: All planted tread centers retain dx_body/dt=-stride*frequency/duty. During all-support transfers their Y changes together by -d(body_shift_Y)/dt; body+Y targets are opposite-side support shifts, not commanded net lateral travel.
limitations: Analytical preparation only: no dynamics, policy, hardware or whole-robot balance validation.
The measured rear-support boundary also has a forward normal; this lateral-only ablation may remain outside the conservative center-point triangle.
No guarantee the physical COM follows the requested body shift, or that scheduled support becomes measured load support.
Root body is assumed level. Shoe finite contact patch/rolling, friction and loaded servo tracking remain dynamic concerns.
Joint-center Y matching does not prove actual pressure-center no-slip motion.
The unchanged two-degree cap may still clip packets after sample holds; startup and stop blending are not bounded by periodic rates.
All-support transfers occupy only duty-.75 of a cycle: lateral body velocity/acceleration can be appreciable even at this low forward speed.
Payload, mass, COM, actuator gains, torque caps and safety limits are unchanged.
